title: Floating point exception (core dumped) in torch.nn.functional.fold

labels.name: module: crash
labels.description: Problem manifests as a hard crash, as opposed to a RuntimeError

labels.name: module: error checking
labels.description: Bugs related to incorrect/lacking error checking

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

import torch
print(f"version:{torch.__version__}",flush=True)
tensor_data = torch.tensor([
    [ 1.4009e-03, -1.3341e-32, -1.3334e-32, -1.3341e-32,  1.2723e-38, 3.6334e+00,  1.5374e-02],
    [-1.5525e-02,  9.2391e-29, -2.5615e-13, -1.3322e-32, -1.3341e-32, -1.3341e-32, -1.3341e-32],
    [-1.3341e-32, -1.3341e-32, -1.3341e-32,  3.0466e+14,  2.3677e+14, 2.3677e+14,  2.3677e+14]
])
mylist = [tensor_data, 16, 7318349394477056]
mydict = {}
torch.nn.functional.fold(*mylist,**mydict)
print("done")
